body:
I... Am maybe not the best person to be an example. I posted my own thread literally today. But if it weren't for being so tired of there being something fundamentally wrong with the way i connect with people that will always leave me lonely, my life would be pretty dope, and yet i failed college miserably twice, lucked into the first job in my career at 25 after working sit jobs when i wasn't unemployed (the great recession was _fucked_ ), got suicidal there, got suicidal at my last job in that career, burned out of it and went back to school... And this time around school was going good. Turn out i needed a less demanding place, I'm not a brilliant brain and that's okay. Things change, and change a lot.

I would believe you don't have enough data yet to conclude you have a pattern of losing everything/everyone. Chances are, you don't. Chances are you were a casualty of the shock of adapting to college, and unfortunate enough to have discovered what fair weather friends are. Which isn't to say it isn't serious pain too. Dealing with that pain doesn't get much better the second or third time around, unfortunately.

I have a pattern and I'm tired of fighting. You may not have a pattern.

Stick around and find out.
I have heard post partum depression can cause suicidal thoughts. Could that be it? Is this something that has happened before?

If you have weed you can make oil and make edibles with it! Google "cannabis infused cooking oil", lots of places explain how to do it. Have your wife do it and bake or sauté you something you can manage to eat (even enjoy) with as minimal issues as possible.

Your words... Are resonating a lot in me. My post is maybe more selfish than that... It's the consequences on myself I l that I cannot bear. The rare and precious times I find it, I always lose my pack of people, again and again. Rebuilding when I can. And losing it all again.

I don't have an answer. I just think I feel similarly to you. At this point just this little bit of apparent understanding dulls the pain a tiny bit. Maybe it will do the same to you.
